description: Creates the form controller: `register`, `handleSubmit`, `formState`, `setError`, `reset`, `watch` and more.
`register(name, rules)` returns `{ name, onChange, onBlur, ref }` to spread on an uncontrolled input.
Wraps your submit function: prevents default, validates, and calls it with the data only when valid.
Proxy with `errors`, `isSubmitting`, `isDirty`, `isValid`... Only properties read during render trigger re-renders.
Adds an error not tied to a field, such as a server response. Cleared on the next submit.
Adapter for controlled third-party inputs that cannot receive a ref.
